q: Do I need prior coding experience to join?
a: No. About half of our new members join with zero prior experience. We run beginner-track workshops every semester.

q: How do I join a sub-team?
a: Fill out the recruitment form on the Join page and pick a sub-team (Tech, Design, Content, or Management). Applications are reviewed by the coordinator of that sub-team.

q: Are DevSoc certificates real proof of participation?
a: Yes. Every certificate we issue has a unique ID that anyone can look up on our Certificate Verification page to confirm it's genuine, who issued it, and what it was issued for.

q: Can I propose my own workshop or project?
a: Yes, any member can propose a workshop or submit a project for the showcase. Submissions go through a short review before going live.
